name: Cinder Ward
description: Wraps an ally in a heated ward. Attacks against the ward scorch the attacker and contribute Heat to the ward's owner.

name: Fire Funnel
description: Creates a spiraling column of flame that corrals enemies toward its center. Stored Heat or Rage can intensify the funnel.

name: Heat Transfer
description: Moves accumulated Heat between linked allies, allowing a support caster to feed a fire specialist's next power spike.

name: Kindled Guardian
description: A reactive ward that becomes hotter each time it prevents harm to its bearer.

name: Living Ember
description: Ignites the caster's bloodline power, causing compatible fire effects to generate Heat instead of behaving as ordinary spells.

name: Ash Mark
description: Marks a target with a smoldering sigil. Repeated attacks build the mark until it erupts when the mark is transferred or detonated.

name: Wildfire Arrow
description: A burning projectile that can pass part of its mark to nearby enemies when the original target is struck again.

name: Furnace Heart
description: Converts accumulated punishment into Heat. At high Heat, the caster's melee abilities become explosive but harder to control.

name: Ember Step
description: Dash through a short space and leave a fading ignition zone behind you.

name: Cinder Song
description: A rhythmic performance that stores Heat in an ally's next elemental attack, empowering it when the rhythm resolves.

name: Burning Grove
description: Conjures living vegetation that ignites in controlled patterns, creating shifting zones of cover and flame.

name: Flameweave
description: Threads a fire spell through a protective ward, allowing flame to pass around protected creatures before striking enemies.

name: Umbra Ward
description: A dark barrier that hides its bearer and clouds the senses of creatures that strike it.

name: Veil Strike
description: Strike from concealment and leave behind a false image that briefly draws enemy attention away from your true position.

name: Eclipse Cast
description: Folds an arcane spell through a veil of darkness, allowing the spell to emerge from an unexpected angle.

name: Dusk Arrow
description: A shadow-laced projectile that marks prey and weakens defenses while the target remains within darkness.

name: Void Step
description: Slip through a momentary tear in space to evade an attack and reappear beside a nearby opening.

name: Grave Benediction
description: Places a protective blessing on a dying ally. If the ally falls, the blessing releases a temporary shadow reservoir that can power recovery magic.

name: Blood Ward
description: Creates a ward fueled by the caster's vitality. Part of an ally's incoming harm can be redirected into the caster's blood reservoir.

name: Crimson Edge
description: Turns stored blood energy into a weapon enhancement that grows stronger as the wielder accumulates controlled wounds.

name: Martyr's Restoration
description: Converts stored Pain into restoration for an ally. Greater restoration requires greater personal sacrifice.

name: Storm Mark
description: Marks prey with a static charge that can jump to another target when the marked creature is struck.

name: Thunder Chant
description: Builds static charge through repeated performance beats and discharges it through an ally's next successful attack.

name: Tempest Smite
description: A divine strike that calls lightning onto enemies already exposed by the paladin's aura.

name: Frost Bind
description: Accumulates Chill on a target. At high Chill, movement becomes severely restricted and the target may freeze.

name: Ice Sanctuary
description: Raises protective ice around an area, trading mobility for powerful cover and damage mitigation.

name: Beast Mark
description: Marks a creature as prey and strengthens tracking, perception, and shapeshift attacks against that target.

name: Bloodfire Ritual
description: Converts vitality and Heat into a temporary surge of volatile spell power. Excess accumulation can become dangerous.

name: Eclipse Flare
description: Combines flame and darkness into a flare that blinds at the edge and burns intensely at the center.

name: Shadowfire Chain
description: Links enemies with a burning shadow tether. Moving apart spreads the effect instead of breaking it immediately.
